title: Taiwan tracks 22 PLA aircraft, 7 naval vessels; 14 cross median line
detail: Taiwan MND figures relayed by Taiwan News: 22 Chinese military aircraft, 7 naval vessels and 5 official ships between 6 a.m. Tuesday and 6 a.m. Wednesday, with 14 aircraft crossing the median line. Single outlet; date inferred from the outlet's relative timestamps.
